          example: radiology

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. When true, the owner is allowed to be created even though another
            owner already has the same last name and address (people who share a household).
            When false or omitted, such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation; it
                carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the owner's
                customerCode. Derived at read time from the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same last
                name and address). Assigned at creation when the request opts in with
                'sharesHousehold: true'; owners in the same household carry the same value.
              type: string
              example: HH-3A7F9C2E1B4D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key that defines owner uniqueness, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's household id (empty when the owner did not opt into a household). A create is
                rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an
                existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. It starts at 1, gains 1
                when an email address is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## What I changed

The `POST /api/owners` pipeline already had a *hard* duplicate check (`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique` → 409). The spec asked for a weaker *soft* match: same lastName + postcode but a different telephone should still be created, just flagged. I implemented it following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions:

1. **New pipeline step** — `FlagOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java`: runs after `FlagOwnerBulkSignup`, before `SaveOwner` (so the new owner isn't compared against itself). It scans existing owners for one sharing the new owner's last name (case-insensitive) and postcode but with a *different* telephone. On a match it sets `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf = <matching id>` (lowest id when several match, for determinism); otherwise `possibleDuplicate = false` and `possibleDuplicateOf = null`. A postcode is required on both sides, so pre-existing postcode-less owners never soft-match.

2. **Wired into** `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` as `flagPossibleDuplicate` (with `govern: [ transaction ]`, matching the surrounding steps).

3. **`Owner` model** — added `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) columns with getters/setters.

4. **Schema SQL** — added `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns to the hsqldb (test), h2, mysql, and postgres `owners` tables.

5. **openapi.yml** — added the two read-only fields to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries them and MapStruct maps them automatically (verified via the `GET /api/owners/{id}` assertions in the test).

The existing frozen-at-creation pattern (like `namesakeCount`/`bulkSignupWarning`) is preserved: the flags are computed once at creation and returned unchanged on later reads.
